newsitem.title: JAPAN: Gajoen Kanko says has 13 billion yen unpaid taxes.
newsitem.headline: Gajoen Kanko says has 13 billion yen unpaid taxes.

text.p: Japanese hotel operator Gajoen Kanko KK said on Monday that it had unpaid taxes totalling about 13 billion yen, including taxes in arrears.

Gajoen has not yet decided how it will pay these taxes, but the company will try to come up with plans on how to do so in a business restructuring plan it will work out in the near future, Gajoen director Minoru Kato told a news conference.

"The company currently possesses the assets necessary and sufficient for carrying out its business, and this (tax issue) will not hinder the company's operations in any way," Gajoen said in a statement.
The Tokyo Stock Exchange had suspended trading in the company's shares on Monday for the entire day due to unclear details on tax-related issues.
Local media reports over the weekend said the hotel operator had unpaid taxes amounting to 10 billion yen.
